description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the JobCategoryDao class, which is a Data Access Object for job categories in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test fixtures, populates test data, and verifies methods like getJobCategoryList and getJobCategoryById.

classes.name: JobCategoryDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing JobCategoryDao methods within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by instantiating JobCategoryDao, setting the fixture path, and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests that the method getJobCategoryList returns a list of three job categories.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests that getJobCategoryById with ID 1 retrieves the correct job category named 'Job Category 1'.
